Objection In the case of the contiguous or joint performance of many sacrifices, we find that if there is anything wrong with the performance of any one of them, then, in accordance with the law laid down under the Sutra VIv, while the other sacrifices have yet to be performed, what is performed over again is only that one sacrifice, and not all of them and the same rule might very well hold in the case in question, where we have a combined or joint material.
